  ORDER BY due_at,sequence LIMIT $7
), resource_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.task_id, sum(octet_length(c.resource_key) + $11) AS bytes
  FROM wfc_scale.hub_task_constraint c JOIN page p ON p.id=c.task_id
  GROUP BY c.task_id
), resources AS (
  SELECT c.task_id, arr

  SELECT id,sequence,hub_id,partition_id,task_type,task_version,workflow_id,epoch,
         lease_until AS deadline
  FROM wfc_scale.hub_task
  WHERE hub_id=$1 AND partition_id % $9=$2 AND attempts < max_attempts

), resource_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (

  FROM wfc_scale.hub_task_constraint c JOIN page p ON p.id=c.task_id
  GROUP BY c.task_id

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id FROM wfc_scale.hub_notification_outbox ORDER BY id
    LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
), removed AS (
    DELETE FROM wfc_scale.hub_notification_outbox o USING picked p
    WHERE o.id=p.id RETURNING o.hub_id,o.matching_payload,o.created_at
)
SELECT pg_notify($2,hub_id),
       pg_notify($3,matching_payload),
       extract($4 FROM (clock_timestamp()-created_at))::double precision
FROM removed

INSERT INTO wfc_scale.hub_notification_outbox(hub_id,matching_payload)
            VALUES (NEW.hub_id,payload)

WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id,sequence,hub_id,partition_id,task_type,task_version,workflow_id,epoch,
         due_at AS deadline
  FROM wfc_scale.hub_task
  WHERE hub_id=$1 AND partition_id % $8=$2 AND attempts < max_attempts
    AND sequence<=$3 AND state=$9 AND due_at<=$4 AND sequence>$5
  ORDER BY sequence LIMIT $6
), resource_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.task_id, sum(octet_length(c.resource_key) + $10) AS bytes
  FROM wfc_scale.hub_task_constraint c JOIN page p ON p.id=c.task_id
  GROUP BY c.task_id
), resources AS (
  SELECT c.task_id, array_agg(c.resource_key

WITH requested AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT unnest($1::uuid[]) AS id
), page AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT t.id,t.sequence,t.hub_id,t.partition_id,t.task_type,t.task_version,t.workflow_id,
         t.epoch,t.due_at,t.lease_until,t.state
  FROM requested r JOIN wfc_scale.hub_task t ON t.id=r.id
  WHERE t.hub_id=$2 AND t.partition_id % $3=$4
    AND t.attempts<t.max_attempts
    AND ((t.state=$6 AND t.due_at<=clock_timestamp())
         OR (t.state=$7 AND t.lease_until<clock_timestamp()))
), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT GREATEST($8,$5/GREATEST(count(*),$9)) AS per_candidate FROM page

SELECT id,hub_id,partition_id,task_type,task_version,workflow_id,
       payload::text,sequence,attempts,COALESCE(workflow_step,native_step_id)
FROM wfc_scale.hub_task t WHERE id = $1
  AND ($2 = $9 OR (t.hub_id = $3 AND t.epoch = $4
    AND EXISTS (SELECT $10 FROM jsonb_to_recordset($5)
        AS capability(hub text, task_type text, version integer)
        WHERE capability.hub = t.hub_id AND capability.task_type = t.task_type
          AND capability.version = t.task_version)))
  AND partition_id % $6 = $7
  AND (task_type NOT IN ($11,$12) OR $8 IS NULL OR EXISTS(
    SELECT $13 F
SELECT $2 FROM ONLY "wfc_scale"."hub_task" x WHERE "id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $1 FOR KEY SHARE OF x

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task
SET state = $4, owner = $1, last_owner = $1,
    epoch = epoch + $5, attempts = attempts + $6,
    lease_until = now() + $2, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $3
RETURNING epoch, lease_until

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task SET state=$5,owner=$6,lease_until=$7,result_json=$1::jsonb,updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$2 AND owner=$3 AND epoch=$4
  AND CASE state WHEN $8 THEN lease_until>clock_timestamp() ELSE $9 END

SELECT c.resource_key, r.capacity, r.strict_fifo
FROM wfc_scale.hub_task_constraint c
JOIN wfc_scale.hub_resource r ON r.resource_key = c.resource_key
WHERE c.task_id = $1 ORDER BY c.resource_key

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.state = $3 AND t.lease_until > now()),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.sequence < $1 AND t.state IN ($4,$5))
FROM wfc_scale.hub_task_constraint c
JOIN wfc_scale.hub_task t ON t.id = c.task_id
WHERE c.resource_key = $2

INSERT INTO wfc_scale.hub_task(id,hub_id,partition_id,task_type,task_version,workflow_id,payload)
SELECT $1,$2,$3,$5,$6,$4,$7::jsonb
FROM wfc_scale.hub_workflow WHERE id=$4 AND native_status=$8
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

SELECT state,owner,last_owner,epoch,lease_until,result_json::text
FROM wfc_scale.hub_task WHERE id=$1 AND workflow_id=$2
  AND task_type=$3 FOR UPDATE

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task_attempt a SET outcome=$2,finished_at=clock_timestamp()
FROM wfc_scale.hub_task t WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND t.workflow_id=$1
  AND a.workflow_id=$1
  AND t.last_error=$3 AND a.finished_at IS NULL

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task SET state=$3,owner=$4,lease_until=$5,
  last_error=$6,updated_at=now()
WHERE workflow_id=$1 AND dispatch_key IS NOT NULL AND state IN ($7,$8)
  AND NOT (dispatch_key=ANY($2))

INSERT INTO wfc_scale.hub_task_constraint(task_id,resource_key)
VALUES ($1,$2)

SELECT COALESCE(max(sequence),$1), clock_timestamp()
FROM wfc_scale.hub_task

SELECT DISTINCT candidates.id,candidates.hub_id FROM (
  SELECT w.id,w.hub_id
  FROM wfc_scale.hub_native_subscription s
  JOIN wfc_scale.hub_workflow w ON w.id=s.workflow_id
  JOIN wfc_scale.hub_native_event e ON e.hub_id=w.hub_id AND e.event_name=s.event_name AND e.event_key=s.event_key
  WHERE w.execution_mode=$2 AND w.native_status IN ($3,$4)
    AND e.effective_at>=s.as_of AND e.effective_at<=now()
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT $5 FROM wfc_scale.hub_native_inbox i WHERE i.workflow_id=w.id
      AND i.pointer_id=s.pointer_id AND i.kind=$6 AND (NOT i.consumed OR i.source_key=e.id::text)

INSERT INTO wfc_scale.hub_task
(id,hub_id,partition_id,task_type,task_version,workflow_id,
 workflow_step,payload)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task_attempt
SET finished_at=clock_timestamp(), outcome=$2
WHERE task_id=$1 AND finished_at IS NULL

SELECT t.hub_id,
       CASE WHEN t.dispatch_key IS NOT NULL THEN $2
            WHEN w.execution_mode=$3 AND t.workflow_step IS NOT NULL
                 AND t.task_type<>$4 THEN $5
            WHEN t.workflow_step IS NOT NULL THEN $6
            ELSE $7 END
FROM wfc_scale.hub_task t
LEFT JOIN wfc_scale.hub_workflow w ON w.id=t.workflow_id
WHERE t.id=$1

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task SET execution_pointer_id=$1,dispatch_key=$2,native_step_id=$3,
  due_at=COALESCE($4::timestamptz,due_at) WHERE id=$5

INSERT INTO wfc_scale.hub_task_attempt
    (task_id,epoch,workflow_id,step_index,attempt_number,worker_id)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)
SELECT $3 FROM wfc_scale.hub_task WHERE workflow_id=$1 AND dispatch_key=$2
SELECT state,last_owner,epoch,result_json::text FROM wfc_scale.hub_task WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT w.id,w.hub_id,w.partition_id,w.native_status,t.execution_pointer_id,t.dispatch_key,t.native_step_id
FROM wfc_scale.hub_workflow w JOIN wfc_scale.hub_task t ON t.workflow_id=w.id
WHERE t.id=$1 AND w.execution_mode=$2 AND t.dispatch_key IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE OF w

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task_attempt SET outcome=$3,finished_at=clock_timestamp()
WHERE task_id=$1 AND epoch=$2 AND finished_at IS NULL

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task SET state=$2,owner=$3,lease_until=$4,last_error=$5,updated_at=now()
WHERE workflow_id=$1 AND state IN ($6,$7)

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_workflow w
SET state=$1,completed_at=now(),updated_at=now(),
    last_error=$2
WHERE w.state IN ($3,$4) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT $5 FROM wfc_scale.hub_task t
    WHERE t.workflow_id=w.id AND t.workflow_step IS NOT NULL
      AND t.state=$6
)

WITH RECURSIVE ready AS (
    (SELECT hub_id FROM wfc_scale.hub_task
     WHERE state=$1 AND due_at<=now()
     ORDER BY hub_id LIMIT $2)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT next.hub_id
    FROM ready previous
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT hub_id FROM wfc_scale.hub_task
        WHERE hub_id>previous.hub_id AND state=$3 AND due_at<=now()
        ORDER BY hub_id LIMIT $4
    ) next
), expired AS (
    (SELECT hub_id FROM wfc_scale.hub_task
     WHERE state=$5 AND lease_until<now() AND attempts<max_attempts
     ORDER BY hub_id LIMIT $6)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT next.hub_id
    F

WITH expired AS (UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task SET state=$1, owner=$2, lease_until=$3,
    updated_at=now(), last_error=coalesce(last_error,$4)
WHERE state=$5 AND lease_until<now() AND attempts>=max_attempts RETURNING id),
closed AS (
  UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task_attempt a SET finished_at=clock_timestamp(),outcome=$6
  FROM expired e WHERE a.task_id=e.id AND a.finished_at IS NULL RETURNING a.task_id
) SELECT count(*) FROM expired

UPDATE wfc_scale.hub_task_attempt a SET outcome=$2,finished_at=clock_timestamp()
FROM wfc_scale.hub_task t WHERE t.id=a.task_id AND t.workflow_id=$1
  AND a.workflow_id=$1
  AND t.last_error=$3 AND a.finished_at IS NULL

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity
        WHERE datname=current_database()),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity
        WHERE datname=current_database() AND state=$1),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM wfc_scale.hub_task WHERE state=$2 AND due_at<=now()),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM wfc_scale.hub_task WHERE state=$3 AND lease_until>now()),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM wfc_scale.hub_task WHERE state=$4)
